expected_behavior: The circular gives two contradictory open dates for the same vessel ("open Jeddah 10 May" vs "ready 20 May"); the parser must extract MV RED SEA PEARL once, must not duplicate the vessel, and must surface the conflict by lowering open_date confidence to uncertain rather than silently picking one date as confirmed.

input.subject: MV RED SEA PEARL - open Jeddah
input.body:
Dear Sirs,

Good day. Pls propose suitable cargo for our Handysize below:

MV RED SEA PEARL
DWT 32,400 mts / DWCC 30,900 mts at 9.9m draft
Flag: Marshall Islands, Built 2011, IMO 9556231
Geared 4 x 30T MacGregor cranes
Grain 42,000 cbm

Open Jeddah 10 May, spsb 1sb

... however pls note master advises she is ready 20 May after completion of current discharge.

L/C: bagged cement, clinker, gypsum

Best rgds,
Faisal

value.display: 10 May (per circular) / ready 20 May (per master) — conflicting

open_date.source_text: Open Jeddah 10 May ... she is ready 20 May
